text:
jared: Quick check — consolidating postmortem actions from INC-834. Can owners confirm open/blocked status and whether anything needs a cross-team gating decision?

sophia: I own the infra rollback task. Status: in progress, PR open, blocked on infra-qa window. ETA tentative 2024-11-05. Need SRE sign-off for the canary.

ekaterina: I have the data-retention cleanup item. Not blocked, just need a docs review for the migration plan. Can do docs by EOD Friday.

matt: I'm on the alerting thresholds work. Quick note — dependent on a config change from platform team (feature flag rollout). Flag owner @devon, can you confirm schedule?

devon: flagged. Platform will flip the flag in the small cluster on Tue (2024-11-07) and prod on Thu if canary looks good. I can slack the rollout window once it's booked.

sophia: @devon please also add a brief rollback play in the rollout message — last time we needed a fast revert.

jared: Good. For traceability, can we list current owners + due dates here so I can update the incident tracker? I'll propose follow-ups after.

ops-bot: Automated reminder: Please ensure each action has an owner and a due date in the RCAsheet. Missing fields detected: infra rollback (due), alert thresholds (due).

ekaterina: RCAsheet updated: data-retention cleanup — owner ekaterina, due 2024-11-08, linked PR 452.

matt: alerting thresholds — owner matt, due 2024-11-09, waiting on @devon flag confirmation.

sophia: infra rollback — owner sophia, due 2024-11-06 (dependent on QA window confirmation). PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/789

jared: Thanks. Two cross-team asks: 1) Platform (devon) to confirm flag rollout windows and include rollback steps; 2) SRE to schedule canary and sign-off for rollback. If either slips >48h we escalate to oncall.

devon: I'll post the rollout schedule by EOD Mon. Rollback steps included.

matt: SRE — who should I ping to book the canary slot?

ekaterina: ping @sre-oncall in the incidents channel, they usually answer fast.

sophia: Noted. I'll update the incident tracker once QA slot is confirmed and ping here.

jared: Perfect. Last ask: any hidden dependencies (legal, compliance, or vendor approvals) anyone knows about? Call them out now so we can gate properly.

devon: No legal deps. We do need a quick vendor approval for the monitoring agent change — vendor support has been CC'd on the PR.

matt: I'll follow up with vendor rep today and paste confirmation here.

jared: Great — plan: I'll take these owners+dates into the tracker and do a status sweep tomorrow. If anything changes, reply in this thread and tag me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
